implementation.detail: Tested commit 0261ca0 changes the allowed optional tools/production_tokenizer.py and adds only tools/pilot_dataset.py, tools/test_pilot_dataset.py, research/data/pilot-dataset.md and configs/data/pilot-sources-v0.2.json. The adapter adds a cached validated tokenizer session and a separate 4 MiB/10,000-document real-pilot training API while preserving synthetic limits. The pilot module implements bounded official acquisition, XHTML/XML extraction with annotation exclusion, lossless UTF-8 segmentation, train-only tokenizer fitting, block-aware <=510-token segmentation, exact labels/masks, canonical manifest and atomic local-only materialization of splot-pilot-blocks-v1. No existing synthetic oracle, shard, harness, CI or model file was changed.

limitations: Small feasibility pilot: 160 blocks / 56,201 content tokens; not a representative sample, scaling result, quality claim or evaluation benchmark.
Prose only; no code, math or technical quota claim.
Tokenizer target/actual vocabulary is 16,384/16,384, but the first model vocabulary remains 32,768 with 16,384 unused logits; no remapping.

Rights are a documented public-domain assessment, not legal clearance or redistribution approval; Standard Ebooks provides U.S. wording and Wolne Lektury annotations remain separately licensed and were excluded.
Polish upstream XML is mutable; local-sha256 pins the frozen snapshot, not an upstream immutable revision.
No model training, test-set loss evaluation, raw-text redistribution or weight-publication approval is included.
Raw text, token arrays, tokenizer JSON, model weights and dataset shards remain local-only and are not in Git.
Hosted CPU CI is required on PR #80 and is not claimed as passed in this evidence.
